RunStarted(run)
ToolCallStart(run, call-1, read)
ToolCallArgs(run, call-1, "{\"path\":\"a.txt\"}")
ToolCallEnd(run, call-1)
ToolCallResult(run, call-1, "contents of a.txt", false)
ToolCallStart(run, call-2, read)
ToolCallArgs(run, call-2, "{\"path\":\"b.txt\"}")
ToolCallEnd(run, call-2)
ToolCallResult(run, call-2, "contents of b.txt", false)
TextMessageStart(run, msg)
TextMessageContent(run, msg, "I read both files.")
TextMessageEnd(run, msg)
RunFinished(run, stop)
